Time in the background before the app locks. The time starts when the phone reports that the app has left the screen, a fraction of a second after you leave it: if you come straight back within that moment, the app is still open, also with Immediately. It is always locked after a restart.
Messages older than this are deleted from this phone whenever the app runs, also while it is locked. A question and its answers go together, up to a day early (3 hours with 1 day).
Messages older than %1$s will be deleted now, and from then on every message when it reaches that age. A chat left without messages is deleted. This cannot be undone.

Lets the app wake for a moment every few hours, also after the phone restarts, to delete what has expired. It never unlocks anything and never loads a model. Off: messages are only deleted when you open the app.

plurals.name: security_finish_answer_on
plurals.item: On: if the app locks by itself while an answer is being written, the screen locks as always and the answer is finished behind it. Until it is finished, for at most %1$d minute, the encryption key stays in memory; then it is erased. Lock now always stops the answer and erases the key at once.

On: if the app locks by itself while an answer is being written, the screen locks as always and the answer is finished behind it. Until it is finished, for at most %1$d minutes, the encryption key stays in memory; then it is erased. Lock now always stops the answer and erases the key at once.

plurals.name: security_finish_answer_off
plurals.item: Off: when the app locks, an answer that is being written is stopped and the encryption key is erased at once. Turn this on to let an answer be finished behind the lock screen, for at most %1$d minute.

Off: when the app locks, an answer that is being written is stopped and the encryption key is erased at once. Turn this on to let an answer be finished behind the lock screen, for at most %1$d minutes.

How much of a conversation this model reads at once, in tokens. It starts at %1$s and grows only when a conversation needs more, which takes more of the phone\'s memory. After the app was locked and left, the whole conversation is read again before the next answer, so a longer conversation means a longer wait. An answer that goes on after the app locks is stopped after ten minutes at the latest, so a conversation that takes longer than that to read is best read with the app open. Beyond the limit chosen here, the oldest messages are left out of an answer.
